'''Drapeflies''' are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are erratic, flying pests that roost in the curtains and rags that litter the dilapidated [[Citadel]]. They are the younger, smaller form of [[Drapelord]]s.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Drapeflies can often be found hanging from ceilings among curtains and inside vents in the Citadel. Once [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches, they will announce their presence with a chirp and take flight to begin their attack.<br>
Being flying enemies, Drapeflies always try to keep distance between themselves and Hornet, and have very good evasive capabilities due to their high speeds. They can easily move out of range in between attacks, and can be hard to take down with the [[Needle]].<br>
Their only attack is to rear back briefly before swooping at Hornet at a low angle, rolling and retreating after the attack until they do it again.

Their attack and contact both deal {{Damage|1}}.

The best strategy to quickly dispose of Drapeflies is to try and corner them, constantly advancing so they are unable to make use of their evasive nature.

Flocks of Drapeflies will harmlessly fly by when walking on the platform outside the [[Memorium]], and on the platforms outside the [[Whispering Vaults]] in [[Act 3]]. 0-2 Drapeflies can appear when this occurs. Flocks of Drapeflies can also be seen flying by in the distant background outside the [[Grand Gate]], eastern entrance to [[The Slab]], [[Choral Chambers]] (including [[Songclave]]), Memorium and [[Whispering Vaults]] at all times.

Several flocks of Drapeflies can be seen flying outside the Citadel during the Act 2 intro cutscene when entering the Choral Chambers for the first time, and briefly during the Act 2 intro cutscene when entering the Grand Gate for the first time.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Drapeflies have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Drapeflies can be found only in and around [[the Citadel]], primarily in the ventilation tunnels of the [[Underworks]], [[Grand Gate]], [[Whiteward]], and [[High Halls]]. They can also be seen roosting in places with plenty of curtains, such as the ceilings of rooms in [[the Slab]], [[Exhaust Organ]], [[Choral Chambers]], and [[Whispering Vaults]]. Lastly, they can be found in the eastern part of the [[Memorium]], on the bridge leading to the [[Putrified Ducts]]. Aside from the initial visit or during the <i>[[The Lost Merchant]]</i> wish, these enemies have a random chance to spawn upon re-entering the room; however, resting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] is not required to reset them.

== Trivia ==
*Drapeflies are heavily inspired by bats, and are named Citadel bats internally.
*Drapeflies constantly shed particles while flying, which are the same particles that curtains and rags break into when destroyed.
